issue.title: sase memory init --no-commit still commits generated chezmoi home instruction files
issue.description: Observed on 2026-08-13 while implementing the approved number_agent_doc_sections plan. From the workspace checkout I ran '.venv/bin/sase memory init --no-commit' expecting render-only behavior. The command exited 0 but printed '[master 96b16784] chore: initialize sase memory'. Inspecting the repo opened via 'sase repo open chezmoi -w 0' shows commit 96b16784 in /home/bryan/.local/share/chezmoi with exactly five generated files modified: home/AGENTS.md, home/CLAUDE.md, home/GEMINI.md, home/OPENCODE.md, and home/QWEN.md. The linked workspace clone remains clean, and the hand-written files AGENTS.md, home/lib/CLAUDE.md, and home/.config/nvim/CLAUDE.md are untouched. Scope: make the memory-init chezmoi deployment path honor --no-commit by writing generated files without creating a git commit or applying/publishing, and add a regression that runs the home/chezmoi memory path with --no-commit.
